title: Noticeable Powdered Snow
description: This project turns the normal basic powdered snow texture from Minecraft, into a more seeable, noticeable one.
body: Ever wanted to not fall into powdered snow in Minecraft anymore? Well now you can, with Noticeable Powdered Snow! This changes the texure of Powdered snow into a more noticeable one so that any eye can spot it from a mile away.
